section.text:
##### 181. 超过经理收入的员工
(https://leetcode.cn/problems/employees-earning-more-than-their-managers/)
重点在理解题意，连接查询
```sql
SELECT
	e1.name as Employee
FROM
	Employee e1
INNER JOIN Employee e2 ON
	e1.managerId = e2.id
WHERE
	e1.salary > e2.salary;
```
子查询
```sql
SELECT
	e1.name AS Employee
FROM
	Employee e1
WHERE
	salary > (
	SELECT
		e2.salary
	FROM
		Employee e2
	WHERE
		e1.managerId = e2.id);
```
总的来说子查询慢的原因是来自子查询中**全表扫描**了两次
